title: Thor v248 - camera inventory off, the first page of a panic names the fault

candidate_change: The camera inventory of v247 does not run: /chosen thor-camera is gone from the device tree. The kernel's code of v247 stays and starts nothing without the property. v247 was flashed on 2026-11-28 at 18:31 and panicked about 43.6 s after boot. The inventory of v247 was due at 43.6 s (thirty seconds after the root volume mounts, at 13.6 s) and no THOR CAMERA line reached the panel; every register read of the inventory comes before its first log line. Not a proof: this image is the test.

The first page of a panic (drawn in the panic hook, before the kernel's own panic path) names the fault: pc, lr, sp and fp with their symbols, esr and far, the thread, and the callers of panic (THOR PANIC V248). Until now the page held only the unformatted panic string. In the panic of v247 the kernel stopped in its own panic path: the panic log never came and no record is known. Once the page is drawn the monitor no longer draws a hang report over it.

The kernel is built in the new layout for the first time: the sources of v247 plus the two changes above. A kernel rebuilt here equals the shipped v247 kernel in 1032 of 1044 objects; the others differ only in integer-overflow checks that the sources exclude.

Carried unchanged from v247: every process that ends by a core-generating signal prints one line (PONG DEATH ...); the log capture library v247 in eight processes including MessagesBlastDoorService; the display library (the panel's size also for a display without a size of its own); the UI adapter in PosterBoard with crash capture; the Wi-Fi station's retries (5 GHz BSS, then plain 802.11g); the Wi-Fi daemon's library and the probe; the Settings diagnostic; the console capture; the firmware LUN check (v243); the retries and the record of a failed check (v242); the panic record slot (v238); the v236 GPU timing hook; the v235 witness.  No boot argument changed; the device tree loses /chosen thor-camera.

config_change.device_tree_changed: v247's without /chosen thor-camera: the camera inventory of v247 does not start; the root node wlan is kept: launchd runs com.apple.wifid only when the device tree names wlan or marconi-wifi
config_change.wifid_start: launchd starts wifid at boot; a library in it waits until configd has published the marker and listed en0 and a power source is on the registry (or 150 s), then wifid runs; killed and started again when it has not asked the driver within 60 s
